title: The Yoga Flow - 10/21/26
description:
The Yoga Flow is a 60-minute, all-levels flow that connects breath, movement, and a dynamic soundscape. Yoga is for every body, beginners and seasoned yogis are welcome here!

Bring your mat and water bottle (no glass please). See you on the mat!
